propositions: Hardcoded Jira mappings in adapters/jira_family/ must be moved to provider-neutral config schema before any axis can become config-driven
Mapping config block must be parsed as reserved section [tool.rebar.mapping] and read raw without triggering _warn_unknown under REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error

Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) must deep-merge per key with precedence built-in ← default ← projects.<KEY>, while vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) must replace wholesale most-specific-wins without unioning

Validation must fail closed offline against effective resolved vocabulary: all axis-map values must appear in declared vocabulary sets, non-string non-skip values must be rejected, and malformed blocks must raise MappingConfigError
Capability dataclass must declare which mapping axes a target has (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) to gate axis validation and operation
mapping_config module must remain provider-neutral, importing nothing from adapters.jira* while allowing adapter injection of built-in defaults and capability values
